explore.goal: Explore this bookshop like a careful first-time buyer: browse the catalog, add books to the cart, change quantities, remove one, check out, sign in with the account you have and review the account and orders pages. Report every defect you have evidence of.
explore.summary: Explored the Bookshelf application across all core flows including catalog browsing, cart management, checkout, authentication, and review of the Account and Orders pages. Found 8 defects, notably a template rendering bug on the homepage, negative stock displays, cart math errors, incorrect item deletion logic in the cart, broken help links, and profile/order history persistence bugs. While the site is navigable, these severe functional issues prevent a reliable purchasing and smooth buying experience.

steps.summary: Signed in as ada@example.test and reviewed Account and Orders pages. Found 2 new defects: Account display name edit is not persisted despite success message, and Orders page claims 2 orders exist while only listing 1.

findings.title: Unrendered template token {{userName}} in homepage greeting
findings.expected: A personalized or generic welcome message without raw template variables like {{userName}}.
findings.actual: Welcome, {{userName}}! You have 0 item(s) in your cart.

findings.title: Negative stock quantity displayed for Neuromancer
findings.expected: In stock quantity should be a non-negative integer (e.g. 0 or greater).

findings.title: Cart total does not reflect increased item quantity
findings.expected: Cart total should equal the sum of the line totals ($28.00 + $9.99 = $37.99).
findings.actual: Line totals are $28.00 (Hyperion x2) and $9.99 (Neuromancer x1), but Cart total displays $23.99.
reproduction: On /cart, click "+" to increase Hyperion quantity to 2

findings.title: Removing second item from cart removes the first item instead
findings.expected: Tapping "Remove Neuromancer" should remove Neuromancer from the cart and leave Hyperion.
findings.actual: Tapping "Remove Neuromancer" (the second item in the cart) removed Hyperion (the first item) instead, leaving Neuromancer in the cart.

findings.title: Misspelling "Recieve" on checkout page newsletter checkbox
Help navigation link points to non-existent URL /hlep
findings.expected: Help link in header should navigate to a valid /help page or help content.
findings.actual: Tapping "Help" navigates to /hlep which shows "Page not found: There is nothing at /hlep."
reproduction: Click "Help" in the main navigation header

findings.title: Account display name edit is not saved despite "Profile saved" confirmation
findings.expected: Display name should be saved and display "Ada Lovelace Updated" after clicking Save profile.
findings.actual: Display name field value is "Ada Lovelace" after saving profile, despite showing status "Profile saved."
reproduction: On /account page, enter "Ada Lovelace Updated" in Display name textbox

findings.title: Orders page claims user has 2 orders but only lists 1 order
findings.expected: The list of orders should contain 2 orders matching the stated count.
findings.actual: Status shows "You have 2 orders.", but only 1 order ("Order #1041 · $23.99 · placed 2026-08-30") is listed in the orders list.
